Create a sprite atlas of exactly 24 isolated full-body poses, 4 columns by 6 rows, portrait canvas. Use the SAME chibi identity, head size, short legs, hair, and SHORT-SLEEVE sports outfit as the input's first pose. Completely transparent background. Full shoes, sleeves above elbows, no cropping. All figures fit in central 72% of each cell. Same body/head scale across all 24 even when seated, no bigger heads on seated frames. Numbering below describes row-major order; no numbers/text in output.
First 6 poses (0-5): holds round biscuit at waist in fingers; raises biscuit to chest; biscuit arrives at LIPS; takes bite at lips; lowers visibly bitten biscuit while chewing eyes closed; smiles with biscuit at waist. All standing with planted feet. No magic wand!
Next 6 (6-11): holds small bowl of rice in left hand and SPOON in right hand by bowl; scoops rice; raises spoon halfway; spoon tip with rice reaches LIPS (not elbow); swallows spoon withdrawing; spoon lowered into bowl, smile. Same planted standing body, actual hands holding utensils, no flying extra rice.
Next 6 (12-17): sitting cross-legged next to three colored small wooden cubes; bends slightly to grasp red cube; carries red cube toward green cube; places red cube directly on green cube; raises blue cube; gently places blue cube atop stack with fingertips touching top block and pleased face. No free-floating cubes.
Final 6 (18-23): standing, comb in right hand at chest; right arm bends comb touches side hair near ear while left hand lightly gathers hair; right hand moves comb DOWN along hair to shoulder. Then standing, small cream soft face cloth at chest in hand; cloth pressed lightly against left cheek with closed eyes; cloth pressed lightly against right cheek, head turns naturally. Every comb/cloth is held by fingers and contacts actual hair/cheek. No external human hands. No floating tools.
Clean cute high quality anime game art, not a scene. Do NOT borrow original maid clothes.
